title: Ameren Illinois Rebates 2026: What We Could and Could Not Confirm
desc: Ameren Illinois serves Peoria and much of central and southern Illinois. We could not read its rebate amounts, so we list what is confirmed: free help, solar credits and what is not offered.
lead: Ameren Illinois delivers electricity and gas across central and southern Illinois, including Peoria. It runs home energy programs, but the page that lists the rebate amounts, AmerenIllinoisSavings.com, refused our automated reader on October 6, 2026. We did not work around that block. So this page shows what we could confirm from other official pages, says plainly what we could not, and points you to the phone line for the rest.
cards_heading: What we confirmed for Ameren Illinois customers
cards_intro: Cards marked "Check first" are ones where we could not confirm an amount. We show no dollar figure for them rather than guess.

cards.title: Ameren Illinois product rebates
cards.note: Ameren points Illinois customers to AmerenIllinoisSavings.com for product discounts and rebates. That site blocked our reader, so no amount is listed here.

cards.title: HVAC Pay As You Save
cards.note: Ameren's own HVAC PAYS page says the program is not available to Illinois customers. It is an Ameren Missouri program, so do not trust ads that suggest otherwise.

cards.title: Peak Time Savings thermostat program
cards.note: Ameren's page lists a $50 sign-up bonus and $25 a year, but its eligibility text names Missouri customers. Confirm for Illinois before you count on it.

cards.title: Home Weatherization Assistance Program
cards.note: State program for households at or below 200% of the federal poverty level. It works through local community action agencies, whatever your utility.

cards.title: Illinois Shines solar credits
cards.note: In Ameren Illinois's area (called Group A) a home solar system of 10 kW or less earns $70.37 per credit in 2026-27. See our Illinois Shines page for how it works.

after_cards: Ameren's efficiency page also lists a free home energy assessment for qualified households, an online marketplace with smart thermostat offers, and a CommunitySavers program for income-eligible customers. We could not read the details for Illinois, so we do not give amounts.
sections: Ameren Illinois serves communities across central and southern Illinois with electricity, gas or both. Peoria is one of them, according to the company's rate schedules. If you are in the Chicago area, your electric company is ComEd and your gas company is Peoples Gas or Nicor Gas, and those pages have read amounts.
Why we do not list amounts

A rebate page with a number we could not read is worse than no page. Our rule is simple: every amount must come from the official page, read on a date we can name. Ameren Illinois's rebate site returned a 403 error to our reader. We did not try to get around it. A person in a normal web browser can open the page, and when we or you do, the amounts will show. Until then, a call to Ameren Illinois is the safe way to learn what applies to your equipment.

Third-party rebate sites do print Ameren Illinois numbers. We do not copy them, because they are often a year behind the utility.

Call before you buy and ask five things. Which equipment is covered this year? Is the rebate paid to you or taken off the bill by the installer? Does the equipment need to be on an approved list? What is the deadline after install? And does the rebate stack with state programs? Write down the name of the person you speak to, the date and the answer.

If your income is under the state limits, apply for free weatherization. For a household of four the limit is $66,000 a year, and you can also qualify if you got help from the Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program in the last 12 months. If you want solar, ask an Illinois Shines approved vendor for a quote that shows the credit payment as a line item. Our Peoria guide pulls these together with local housing numbers.

The federal tax credits for heat pumps, insulation and solar ended for work done after December 31, 2025, so we do not count on them.
claim_heading: How to find your Ameren Illinois rebate
claim_steps: Confirm Ameren Illinois is your electric or gas company on your bill.
Open AmerenIllinoisSavings.com in a normal web browser and look at the products and rebates page.
Call Ameren Illinois to confirm any amount you find, especially for heat pumps and thermostats.
Keep invoices and model numbers, and ask whether the contractor files the paperwork.
If you qualify by income, apply for free weatherization through your local community action agency.
faq: How much does Ameren Illinois pay for a heat pump?
We could not confirm an amount. Ameren Illinois's rebate site blocked our reader, so call Ameren Illinois before you buy.
Is HVAC Pay As You Save available in Illinois?
No. Ameren's HVAC PAYS page says it is not available for Illinois customers.
Does Ameren Illinois have a smart thermostat program?
Ameren lists a Peak Time Savings program with a $50 sign-up bonus, but its eligibility text names Missouri customers, so confirm for Illinois.
If your household income is at or below 200 percent of the federal poverty level, yes, through the state's Home Weatherization Assistance Program.
Illinois Shines pays for solar credits. In the Ameren Illinois area, a home system of 10 kW or less earns $70.37 per credit in the 2026-27 year.
